schema.text: Should a continuous walking space be added here?
schema.help: A continuous walking space is a sidewalk or path without gaps along the whole stretch.

en.#Should a continuous walking space be ad: Should a continuous walking space be added here?
en.#A continuous walking space is a sidewal: A continuous walking space is a sidewalk or path without gaps along the whole stretch.

it.#Should a continuous walking space be ad: Servirebbe qui uno spazio continuo per camminare?
it.#A continuous walking space is a sidewal: Uno spazio pedonale continuo è un marciapiede o percorso senza interruzioni lungo tutto il tratto.

fr.#Should a continuous walking space be ad: Faudrait-il ajouter ici un espace continu pour marcher ?
fr.#A continuous walking space is a sidewal: Un espace piéton continu est un trottoir ou un chemin sans interruption sur tout le tronçon.

de.#Should a continuous walking space be ad: Sollte hier ein durchgehender Gehbereich angelegt werden?
de.#A continuous walking space is a sidewal: Ein durchgehender Gehbereich ist ein Gehweg oder Weg ohne Unterbrechung auf dem ganzen Abschnitt.

tr.#Should a continuous walking space be ad: Buraya kesintisiz bir yürüme alanı eklenmeli mi?
tr.#A continuous walking space is a sidewal: Kesintisiz yürüme alanı, bölüm boyunca hiç kesilmeyen bir kaldırım veya yoldur.

fa.#Should a continuous walking space be ad: آیا باید اینجا یک فضای پیوسته برای پیاده‌روی اضافه شود؟
fa.#A continuous walking space is a sidewal: فضای پیاده‌روی پیوسته پیاده‌رو یا مسیری بدون قطعی در تمام این بخش است.

hu.#Should a continuous walking space be ad: Kellene-e itt folyamatos gyalogos helyet kialakítani?
hu.#A continuous walking space is a sidewal: A folyamatos gyalogos tér olyan járda vagy út, amely a teljes szakaszon megszakítás nélkül fut végig.

ar.#Should a continuous walking space be ad: هل يجب إضافة مساحة مشي متصلة هنا؟
ar.#A continuous walking space is a sidewal: مساحة المشي المتصلة رصيف أو مسار بلا انقطاع على طول المقطع كله.
